refero:9972.summary: From the week calendar, click a time cell, fill in client, provider and services, confirm with notify, and save the appointment.
steps: Empty week; provider filter Liam; Add
New appointment panel: time, client, provider, services
Client search list plus Add New Client
Services picker with duration, price, end buffer
Stacked services; end time calculated; preview
Book appointment confirm with notify checkbox
Confirm Book it with notify on
Booked block: John Doe, 3 services, Nail Room #1
steal: Clicking a calendar cell opens a side panel with the start time already filled (screens 2 to 3).
One form covers person, provider and multi-service Add; end time is derived from the sum (screens 3, 6 to 7).
Each service has duration plus a '10m block at the end' buffer, and the room sits on the card (screens 5 to 7).
A confirm step with 'Notify client via email and text' comes before commit (screens 8 to 9).
avoid: One client per appointment only leaves no group or capacity roster for 4 to 10 learners in one slot.
refero:9972.fit: Scheduling: best proxy for simple events: scenario(s), room, faculty and learner from a calendar cell. Multi-service maps to multi-station rotation in one booking; extend with group capacity.
